a.description: input array of shape ``(..., N, N)``
constraints: input array 'a' must have at least 2 dimensions
last two dimensions of 'a' must match, i.e., be of size N

output.description: Specify whether to compute the ``"real"`` (default) or ``"complex"`` Schur decomposition.

A tuple of arrays ``(T, Z)`` - ``T`` is a shape ``(..., N, N)`` array containing the upper-triangular Schur form of the input. - ``Z`` is a shape ``(..., N, N)`` array containing the unitary Schur transformation matrix.
